description: The '1.6× A=3 magnitude near-miss' is dimensionally ill-posed AND scale-ambiguous. The 3-body cluster c₃=0.297 is a genuine ENERGY (E₀·deficit) compared directly to the DIMENSIONLESS μ₃=0.4708 (borromean probe:188 admits 'μ₃ dimensionless, read as MeV'). Repairing the pun does NOT give one 'honest gap': the categorical binding scale is unpinned — the master formula undershoots the DEUTERON by 5.85× (C_knot=B_AME/B_cat, an explicitly FITTED deficit ratio = the open Δ_λ gate). Normalizing c₃ by the AME deuteron gives a 3.53× UNDERSHOOT; by the categorical deuteron (scale-consistent, E₀/m_e cancels) a 1.66× OVERSHOOT — the two differ by exactly C_knot=5.85. So the near-miss is an artifact of the unpinned scale, not a robust proximity. (Self-correction: an earlier version reported 3.53× as 'the honest gap' — that picked one normalization and over-claimed.) The unambiguous object is C_knot itself; deriving it (the Δ_λ magnitude) is 'how to improve binding' and is currently a FIT (six ansätze + three walls failed). scope-(a) calibration; no fit; nothing wired; exact (mpmath). Corpus files carry the pun — flagged for coordination.
